response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major) SELECT major_id, member_count, CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_members, member_count / AVG(member_count) OVER () AS count_to_average_ratio FROM major_counts ORDER BY count_to_average_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
